# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 4 tokens; Text — 3 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 3 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 23 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 6 tokens; Radius — 3 tokens; Shadow — 1 token; Size — 6 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the dark theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--surface-0, #101214);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="light" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the light column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--surface-0, #b8bcc2);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #101214;
```

### Tokens (4)

| token | dark | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--surface-0` | #101214 | #b8bcc2 | App ground between panels and the splitter gap. No text directly on it. |
| `--surface-1` | #1a1d21 | #d9dce0 | Panel body: properties panel, texture browser, log, toolbar. |
| `--surface-2` | #252a30 | #eef0f2 | Raised surfaces: panel title bars, inputs, menus, floating windows. |
| `--surface-3` | #313740 | #ffffff | Hover state on surface-2 and pressed buttons. |

## Color · Text

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the dark theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--ink, #e7eaee);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="light" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the light column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--ink, #14171a);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #e7eaee;
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | dark | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--ink` | #e7eaee | #14171a | Body text and headings on surface-0 to surface-3. |
| `--ink-muted` | #9ba3ae | #4c535c | Secondary text: coordinates, metadata, empty fields, the (new key) row. On surface-1 and surface-2. |

**Interaction states** (same roles, suffixed):

| token | dark | light |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--ink-disabled` | #6a717b | #7c838c |

## Color · Fills and status backgrounds

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the dark theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--on-accent, #0b1030);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="light" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the light column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--on-accent, #ffffff);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #0b1030;
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | dark | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--on-accent` | #0b1030 | #ffffff | Text and icons on an accent fill. |
| `--accent-soft` | #252f5c | #d4dafb | Background of a selected row in trees and lists when the selection is not focused. |
| `--on-select` | #ffffff | #ffffff | Text on a select fill. |

## Color · Palette ramps and brand

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the dark theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--line, #3a4049);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="light" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the light column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--line, #9aa0a8);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #3a4049;
```

### Tokens (23)

| token | dark | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--line` | #3a4049 | #9aa0a8 | Panel borders, table cell rules, separators. Decorative; never the only sign of a state. |
| `--line-strong` | #6b7380 | #5f6670 | Input and button borders (≥3:1 on surface-1 and surface-2 in both themes). |
| `--accent` | #7b93ff | #2c43b8 | Active view, highlighted menu row, selected tab, primary button. Qoole's blue active-window title bar. As text, on surface-1 and surface-2. |
| `--focus-ring` | #a9b8ff | #1e33a3 | Keyboard focus: a solid 2px ring after a 1px gap. ≥3:1 on every surface token. |
| `--select` | #cf2b22 | #c8261d | Selected item in the UI: the selected texture's name label, the selected node's marker. Means the same as vp-select in the viewports. |
| `--warn` | #f0a43a | #8a5300 | Warning: Tex Lock error over 0.5 texels, surface flag differing from the texture default, compiler warning in the log. As text on surface-1 and surface-2; always with an icon or a word. |
| `--error` | #ff7a70 | #b3261e | Error: compile error, leak, rejected geometry. As text on surface-1 and surface-2; always with an icon or a word. |
| `--ok` | #5cc8ff | #0b5e91 | Successful compile in the log. Blue, not green, so ok and error differ without relying on red–green. |
| `--vp-bg` | #000000 | #000000 | Background of all four views in both themes, as in Qoole. |
| `--vp-grid-minor` | #262626 | #262626 | Grid lines at the current grid size. Fade out when spacing drops below 4px. |
| `--vp-grid-major` | #4d4d4d | #4d4d4d | Every 8th grid line and every 64 units. |
| `--vp-axis` | #6e6a32 | #6e6a32 | World origin axes (x = 0, y = 0, z = 0) in the 2D views. |
| `--vp-brush` | #e6e6e6 | #e6e6e6 | Unselected brush wireframe in the 2D views and 3D wireframe mode. |
| `--vp-select` | #ff2b1f | #ff2b1f | Selected brush or entity in every view. Selection is never shown in any other color. |
| `--vp-entity` | #3ccaff | #3ccaff | Point entities in the 2D views when the entity definition gives no color. |
| `--vp-target` | #1c86b3 | #1c86b3 | target/targetname link lines in the 2D views, dashed. |
| `--vp-handle` | #ffd60a | #ffd60a | Vertex, edge and face handles, and clip plane points. |
| `--vp-invalid` | #ff9f0a | #ff9f0a | Rejected move (non-convex result). Departs from the spec, which says red: red is reserved for selection. |
| `--vp-leak` | #e040fb | #e040fb | qbsp3 leak path (.pts) in every view. |
| `--vp-sky` | #5f7898 | #5f7898 | SURF_SKY faces in the 3D view. |
| `--vp-toolface` | #7a52c7 | #7a52c7 | SURF_NODRAW, clip and hint faces in the 3D view, dimmed (drawn at 35% opacity). |
| `--vp-scope-dim` | #5a5a5a | #5a5a5a | The rest of the map while inside a group (scope): wireframe in this color. |
| `--vp-label` | #c9c9c9 | #c9c9c9 | Text drawn over a view: measurements, handle coordinates. |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 600 13px/18px "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-ui-heading);
font-family: var(--font-ui);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line, italic, letter spacing | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-heading` | `.ui-heading`, `--text-ui-heading` | 13px / 18px | 600 | `ui` | Floating window and panel group titles. |
| `ui-title` | `.ui-title`, `--text-ui-title` | 12px / 16px | 600 | `ui` | Panel and view title bars. |
| `ui-body` | `.ui-body`, `--text-ui-body` | 12px / 16px | 400 | `ui` | Menus, buttons, forms, tree view. The default style. |
| `ui-small` | `.ui-small`, `--text-ui-small` | 11px / 14px | 400 | `ui` | Tabs, tooltips, shortcuts. |
| `ui-label` | `.ui-label`, `--text-ui-label` | 10px / 12px, letter-spacing 0.06em | 600 | `ui` | Uppercase group labels inside a panel. |
| `mono-body` | `.mono-body`, `--text-mono-body` | 12px / 16px | 400 | `mono` | Key–value tables, the log, .map text. |
| `mono-small` | `.mono-small`, `--text-mono-small` | 11px / 14px | 400 | `mono` | Texture names, title bar coordinates, grid size. |

### Families

| family | CSS variable | stack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ui` | `--font-ui` | `"IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif` |
| `mono` | `--font-mono` | `"IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace` |

## Spacing

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 2px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--space-2xs);
```

### Tokens (6)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-2xs` | 2px | Gap between icon and edge in a button; handle radius. |
| `--space-xs` | 4px | Tight padding: tabs, gap between toolbar buttons. |
| `--space-sm` | 6px | Horizontal cell padding in tables and menu row indent. |
| `--space-md` | 8px | Panel padding, gap between texture tiles. |
| `--space-lg` | 12px | Floating window padding, gap between groups in a panel. |
| `--space-xl` | 16px | Gap between sections in the properties panel. |

### Use

/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below (--radius-none: 0px) */

```

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--radius-none` | 0px | Views, panels and splitters. The workspace is a rectangular grid. |

/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer var(--shadow-float), so that a change to tokens.css, or a change of theme, reaches the page */
```

### Tokens (1)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--shadow-float` | 0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.55) · light: 0 6px 20px rgba(20,24,30,0.22) | Menus, submenus and floating windows. Every other surface is flat. |
